answer: Pre-dermal condensate cells migrate towards the epidermis and aggregate to form the dermal condensate (Dc). During migration, genes ADAMST1, CLDN11, and CXCL12 are upregulated. As they aggregate into the Dc, genes COL6A3, MFAP4, and PTK7 are expressed.
support_quote: Along the hair fibroblast pseudotime, genes involved in regulation of cell adhesion (ADAMST1), cell-cell contacts (CLDN11) and directed migration (CXCL12) were upregulated as pre-Dc cells migrated towards the epidermis, which indicated a process of collective migration. Genes implicated in collagen fibril formation and cell adhesion (COL6A3, MFAP4 and PTK7) were expressed as the pre-Dc cells aggregated into the Dc
